# Enforce the workload resource envelope

<!-- grove:slice-contract parent=trickle-labs/rockstream#132 slice=S1 -->

## Parent and contribution

Parent source: [issue #132](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/132) and [immutable v0.72 source plan](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/blob/6442838183ffd913b6a24860072575aacaa9c96a/docs/implementation-plans/v0.72.md).
Parent contract: [docs/acceptance-contracts/132.md](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/blob/7a73050dbb28fdf61584d052b9521b2e7dce9835/docs/acceptance-contracts/132.md), revision v2, SHA-256 cc91b392f193e771e38336c7da3c62480ef7337083ce1a5c301f576096335734.
Decomposition: [canonical nine-slice index](https://github.com/trickle-labs/rockstream/issues/132#issuecomment-5832445481).
Contribution: trickle-labs/rockstream#132 v2:R2, trickle-labs/rockstream#132 v2:R3, trickle-labs/rockstream#132 v2:R4, trickle-labs/rockstream#132 v2:R5, trickle-labs/rockstream#132 v2:R6. R6 is consolidated here; S2-S4 enforce the limits in their own paths.

## What this delivers

Worker and workload allocations have one owner, soft pressure slows producers, hard pressure rejects within the envelope, and bounded resources expose fill and overflow behavior.

## Acceptance criteria for this slice

- Account for all seven v0.72 memory classes plus SlateDB write buffers, block and metadata caches, and local object-store cache; charge shared allocations once, including catalog/cache ownership.
- Use prospective admission and drop-safe release for success, error, cancellation, shard removal, and restart; reconcile ledger totals with RSS and documented allocator overhead.
- Throttle or adapt source and exchange producers at the frozen soft limit; reject or truthfully degrade before the hard limit with failed-reservation rollback and exact output.
- Inventory each queue, retry set, scan, migration buffer, result, and waiter with a named limit, fill observation, and overflow policy. Delegate commit, interactive-query, and subscription resources to S2-S4 while retaining the consolidated R6 check.

## Inherited constraints and non-goals

Use the frozen workload and worker limits, earlier worker-storage guarantees, exact committed results, and no silent drops. No unrelated allocator or cache redesign. The parent v2 contract, repository standards, and applicable earlier milestone guarantees remain binding. Confirm their linked evidence before dependent qualification.

## Blocked by

No child work blocker. Before dependent qualification, confirm the earlier sign-off outcomes and linked evidence named in the parent contract.

## Evidence approach and open decisions

Public workload and worker status plus exact allocation, pressure, boundary, overflow, and RSS transcripts: v072_memory_ownership, v072_memory_lifecycle, v072_soft_pressure, v072_hard_pressure, v072_bounded_resources.
Relevant existing seams: crates/rockstream-types/src/state_budget.rs; crates/rockstream-storage/src/storage_context.rs; crates/rockstream-runtime/src/quota.rs and source_pressure.rs.
The parent contract settles the outcome and public seams; no open product decision is allocated to this ticket. Checks need exact observed outputs and independent expected results, not counts alone.

## Handoff

Run /plan-acceptance on this ticket and map each child requirement's Source to the qualified parent obligations above. Child criteria are source material, not an issued child contract. Confirm prerequisite outcomes before implementation. Child completion does not establish parent acceptance.
